description: SIDERA VI is driven by curiosity, innovation, and the spirit of discovery. For the Martian Map challenge, we envision an interactive exploration companion that transforms NASA data into practical tools for navigating Mars. From real terrain maps and simulated positioning to solar time, orientation, and mission planning, our goal is to help future explorers understand their surroundings and make informed decisions. We believe the next great leap begins with the courage to explore the unknown.
